profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Realtor.com
profile.summary:
Staff-level DevOps and infrastructure engineer with a track record designing and scaling Kubernetes platforms, observability stacks, CI/CD pipelines, secrets management, and cloud infrastructure across semiconductor, robotics, media, and SaaS environments.
I specialize in improving reliability, developer experience, and release velocity through platform standardization, automation, and cross-functional technical leadership — across both cloud and on-prem environments.

positions.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
- Built and supported Kubernetes and Nomad platforms across cloud and on-prem, improving reliability and consistency for internal engineering teams
- Expanded observability with Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, Alloy, and Grafana to improve platform health visibility and incident response
- Led migration from Jenkins to GitHub Actions, improving CI/CD maintainability, security, and developer experience across teams
- Automated GPU-backed infrastructure for AI/ML workloads; served on the AI Council defining internal guidance

positions.title: Senior Robot Infrastructure Engineer
positions.description:
- Built a GKE observability platform using Prometheus, Thanos, and Grafana Cloud to ingest and retain metrics from 100+ IoT edge devices
- Developed Python Prometheus exporters for SIM, network, and system health; automated remote device configuration with Ansible
- Designed a HashiCorp Vault platform on GKE enabling dynamic short-lived credentials and Workload Identity-based authentication
- Created GPU-enabled GitLab runners and secured platform access with Google OIDC and Kubernetes RBAC

positions.title: Senior Systems Reliability Engineer
positions.description:
- Embedded with the Marvel team to design and operate highly available, secure systems for mission-critical applications
- Onboarded legacy workloads to Istio service mesh using sidecar injection, traffic shifting, and circuit-breaking policies
- Reduced slowest pipeline release times by 95% through improved Datadog observability and stronger SLO/SLI practices
- Automated deployments with Argo CD on AWS EKS; built secure release pipelines for Marvel's Render Farm and ML/AI infrastructure

positions.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
- Redesigned production AWS infrastructure with Terraform and Terragrunt for improved scalability, reliability, and repeatability
- Migrated workloads from AWS LightSail to EKS Fargate while maintaining HIPAA compliance requirements
- Guided engineering teams through containerization and platform adoption, driving performance and security improvements through automation

positions.title: Production Engineer and TOC Team Lead
positions.description:
- Built automation to reduce operational toil and improve scalability across production platforms
- Improved alerting and monitoring to accelerate identification and resolution of critical system issues
- Supported migrations to AWS and GCP while leading Technical Operations Center activities focused on reliability, security, and platform performance

positions.title: Junior Admin Trainer
positions.description:
- Trained new hire technical support staff on web hosting infrastructure including cPanel/WHM, DNS, Apache, and CMS platforms (WordPress, Joomla, Drupal)
- Conducted chat/call audits and provided management with trainee performance assessments to maintain quality and procedure compliance
- Collaborated with the Director of Training to maintain and improve training processes using Moodle-based curriculum delivery
